about: Hand-picked, evergreen Montreal experiences. Only places whose position was confirmed: coordinates © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), geocoded with Nominatim on 2026-10-26, most matched by the place's own name in OSM. No opening hours or prices are claimed beyond what is stated.

experiences.title: The bagel duel
experiences.description: Get a sesame bagel at St-Viateur, then one at Fairmount a few blocks away. Pick a side.

experiences.title: Smoked meat at Schwartz's
experiences.description: A smoked meat sandwich at the counter, on the Main.

experiences.title: Late-night poutine at La Banquise
experiences.description: Poutine on Rue Rachel, best after a night out.

experiences.title: The view from Kondiaronk
experiences.description: The downtown skyline from the Mount Royal lookout. Go for the sunset.

experiences.title: Tam-Tams on Mount Royal
experiences.description: Drummers and dancers around the Cartier monument on Sunday afternoons in the warm months.

experiences.title: Jean-Talon Market
experiences.description: Produce stands, cheese and maple at the big open-air market in Little Italy.

experiences.title: The Lachine Canal from Atwater Market
experiences.description: Grab something at the market, then walk or ride along the canal path.

experiences.title: Habitat 67 up close
experiences.description: Moshe Safdie's stacked concrete boxes, built for Expo 67. Walk around them on Avenue Pierre-Dupuy.

experiences.title: The Special at Wilensky's
experiences.description: The pressed sandwich at the Mile End lunch counter.

experiences.title: Skate on Beaver Lake
experiences.description: Outdoor skating on Mount Royal's lake once it freezes.

experiences.title: Climb up to Saint Joseph's Oratory
experiences.description: From Chemin Queen-Mary, take the stairs up to the dome with the city behind you.

experiences.title: The tiki bar under the green pineapple
experiences.description: Find the neon pineapple in Chinatown and go down the stairs.

experiences.title: Carré Saint-Louis
experiences.description: The fountain and the painted Victorian houses at the end of Prince-Arthur.
